task.title: Saving new tasks on web now feels slow
task.description:
We built optimistic web mutations (WB-01KYM85R7X6FSFR5ER7ZDJ8T3N) for the task board, but not for saving new tasks. Currently when creating a new task, it takes more than a second after clicking "Save" to see the new task rendered.
Once WB-01KZEY684G50106M1QDF5ZRB8P (new task save returns to main task view) is implemented, we should optimize the save path so that users get instant redirection and an error message if their task save fails.
